correctness.rationale: The finite pseudoperiod condition is prefix-closed and each extension introduces exactly one new equation. Power avoidance is also prefix-closed; any newly created forbidden power is a suffix. For each period p, checking the suffix of length ceil(55p/21) is necessary and sufficient for creation of a factor with exponent at least 55/21. Two independently coded exhaustive engines agree on every level through length 201, yielding exactly two words at length 200 and none at 201. Whole-word rescans verify both boundary words.
